# CMAKE CONFIGURATION FILE FOR SMOKEMIN SOLVER
#
# Based on the EM4 solver CMake configuration. Options and compiler flags
# from the parent CMakeLists.txt propagate through here.
#
# Generated by dendrosym. Safe to edit.

find_package(OpenMP REQUIRED)
find_package(MPI REQUIRED)
find_package(GSL REQUIRED)

# ===========================
# solver-specific options
# ===========================
option(SOLVER_PROFILE_HUMAN_READABLE "Enable human readable profile outputs" OFF)
option(SOLVER_CONSEC_COMM_SELECT
  "Rank selection using consecutive ranks (works with arbitrary number of processes)" ON)
option(SOLVER_ENABLE_VTU_OUTPUT "Enables VTU output" ON)
option(SOLVER_COMPUTE_CONSTRAINTS "Enables constraint equation computation" ON)
option(SOLVER_ENABLE_VTU_CONSTRAINT_OUTPUT "Writes constraint output to VTU file" ON)
option(SOLVER_ENABLE_PROFILING "Enable solver profiling timers" ON)

# derivative order (only one active at a time)
option(SOLVER_USE_4TH_ORDER_DERIVS "Use 4th order derivative stencils" OFF)
option(SOLVER_USE_6TH_ORDER_DERIVS "Use 6th order derivative stencils" ON)
option(SOLVER_USE_8TH_ORDER_DERIVS "Use 8th order derivative stencils" OFF)

if(SOLVER_USE_4TH_ORDER_DERIVS)
  set(SOLVER_USE_6TH_ORDER_DERIVS OFF)
  set(SOLVER_USE_8TH_ORDER_DERIVS OFF)
elseif(SOLVER_USE_6TH_ORDER_DERIVS)
  set(SOLVER_USE_4TH_ORDER_DERIVS OFF)
  set(SOLVER_USE_8TH_ORDER_DERIVS OFF)
elseif(SOLVER_USE_8TH_ORDER_DERIVS)
  set(SOLVER_USE_4TH_ORDER_DERIVS OFF)
  set(SOLVER_USE_6TH_ORDER_DERIVS OFF)
endif()

if(DENDRO_USE_NEW_DERIVS)
  # when using the new DendroDerivatives system, the order selection
  # is done at runtime via the TOML file, but we still need a default
  # for any legacy code paths
  message(STATUS "DendroDerivatives enabled -- derivative order is runtime-configurable")
  set(SOLVER_USE_6TH_ORDER_DERIVS ON)
endif()

# ===========================
# source files
# ===========================
set(SOLVER_SRC_FILES
    src/parameters.cpp
    src/grUtils.cpp
    src/rhs.cpp
    src/smokeminCtx.cpp
    src/physcon.cpp
    src/profile_params.cpp
)

set(SOLVER_INCLUDE_DIRS
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
)

add_library(solver_common OBJECT ${SOLVER_SRC_FILES})
target_include_directories(solver_common PUBLIC ${SOLVER_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_link_libraries(solver_common PUBLIC dendro5 MPI::MPI_CXX GSL::gsl toml11::toml11)

# ===========================
# compile definitions
# ===========================
macro(solver_add_def OPTION_NAME DEF_NAME)
  if(${OPTION_NAME})
    target_compile_definitions(solver_common PUBLIC ${DEF_NAME})
  endif()
endmacro()

solver_add_def(SOLVER_USE_4TH_ORDER_DERIVS SOLVER_USE_4TH_ORDER_DERIVS)
solver_add_def(SOLVER_USE_6TH_ORDER_DERIVS SOLVER_USE_6TH_ORDER_DERIVS)
solver_add_def(SOLVER_USE_8TH_ORDER_DERIVS SOLVER_USE_8TH_ORDER_DERIVS)
solver_add_def(SOLVER_PROFILE_HUMAN_READABLE SOLVER_PROFILE_HUMAN_READABLE)
solver_add_def(SOLVER_CONSEC_COMM_SELECT SOLVER_CONSEC_COMM_SELECT)
solver_add_def(SOLVER_ENABLE_VTU_OUTPUT SOLVER_ENABLE_VTU_OUTPUT)
solver_add_def(SOLVER_COMPUTE_CONSTRAINTS SOLVER_COMPUTE_CONSTRAINTS)
solver_add_def(SOLVER_ENABLE_VTU_CONSTRAINT_OUTPUT SOLVER_ENABLE_VTU_CONSTRAINT_OUTPUT)

if(SOLVER_ENABLE_PROFILING)
  target_compile_definitions(solver_common PUBLIC SOLVER_ENABLE_PROFILING)
  target_compile_definitions(solver_common PUBLIC __PROFILE_CTX__)
  target_compile_definitions(solver_common PUBLIC __PROFILE_ETS__)
endif()


# ===========================
# main solver executable
# ===========================
macro(solver_add_executable TARGET_NAME)
  add_executable(${TARGET_NAME} ${ARGN})
  target_link_libraries(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE
      solver_common dendro5 MPI::MPI_CXX GSL::gsl toml11::toml11 m)
endmacro()


solver_add_executable(smokeminSolver smokemin_main.cpp)


# GR headers (bh.h, adm2bssn.h, tpid_params.h, etc.) from dendrolib
if(IS_DIRECTORY "${DENDRO_dendrolib_DIR}/GR/include")
    target_include_directories(solver_common PUBLIC ${DENDRO_dendrolib_DIR}/GR/include)
endif()
